reactions.label: The market's move after the 8-K of 2026-11-12 (items 5.02, 9.01)
reactions.display: +1.4% against the index over 3 trading days, 0.4 times its normal 3-day move (up)
assumptions: Start: the last close before the filing day (an 8-K filed after the close moves the next day's price).
The index gives the filing's day, not its hour: for an 8-K accepted after the close, the filing day is a day of the window on which nothing was known.
Excess return = the stock's return − the index's over the same dates; not adjusted for beta.
Nothing after the as-of date is read.
